title: Baby Crawling on Backyard Blanket, 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A sunny mid-century backyard snapshot capturing an infant girl or boy happily crawling across a patterned quilted blanket laid on the lawn. In the background, a portable wooden playpen stands with a cloth or towel draped over its rail. Cast shadows indicate strong midday sunlight, embodying the post-war domestic boom and everyday suburban family life of early 1950s America.
